scene.en: Li orders a coffee and a cinnamon bun.
scene.zh: Li 点一杯咖啡和一个肉桂卷。

lines: “Vad vill du ha?” is what you will hear in every café and shop.
“Vad vill du ha?” 在所有咖啡馆和商店都会听到。
Swedish has no word for “please”; you add “tack” (thanks) at the end instead.
瑞典语没有“请”这个词，用句尾的“tack”代替。
Vill du ha en stor eller en liten?
Would you like a large or a small one?
En stor, tack. Och en kanelbulle.
A large one, please. And a cinnamon bun.
大杯，谢谢。再来一个肉桂卷。
Nej tack, det är bra så.
Det blir sextiofem kronor. Kort eller Swish?
That'll be sixty-five kronor. Card or Swish?
一共 65 克朗。刷卡还是 Swish？
“Det blir …” (“it becomes …”) is how prices are announced.
“Det blir …”（“变成……”）是报价格的固定说法。
Card, please. Where is the milk?
Den står där borta, vid fönstret.
It's over there, by the window.
Things that stand upright “står”; “där borta” = over there.
立着放的东西用“står”；“där borta” = 那边。
You're welcome. Have a nice day!
“Varsågod” is both “here you are” and “you're welcome”.
